description: Source code for FreeType library's bounding box computation, including functions for outline decomposition and extrema calculation.

classes.name: TBBox_Rec_
classes.description: Structure holding last point and bounding box during outline processing.

methods.name: BBox_Move_To
methods.description: Records move-to point and updates bounding box.

methods.name: BBox_Conic_Check
methods.description: Finds extrema of conic Bezier curve segment and updates min/max.

methods.name: BBox_Conic_To
methods.description: Handles conic Bezier segment, updates bounding box extrema.

methods.name: cubic_peak
methods.description: Finds peak of cubic Bezier segment using iterative bisection.

methods.name: BBox_Cubic_Check
methods.description: Finds extrema of cubic Bezier curve segment and updates min/max.

methods.name: BBox_Cubic_To
methods.description: Handles cubic Bezier segment, updates bounding box extrema.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Get_BBox
methods.description: Computes the bounding box of an outline, including Bezier extrema.
